Acute myeloid leukemia is a malignant disorder of marrow myeloid cells; no common additional organ damage is established here.
Thrombosis directly affects the carotid arteries; cerebral infarction is a separately diagnosed complication, and transient ischemia does not establish lasting damage.
NEK2-related rod-cone retinal degeneration; no extraocular disease is established.
Myotonia, skeletal dysplasia and profound intellectual disability define the syndrome; dysphagia alone does not establish gastrointestinal damage.
Hair, skin and nail disease define TTD; developmental disability/ataxia and skeletal abnormalities occurred in 1/1 reported patient; frequency estimates are limited.
Hereditary dystonia associated with structural skeletal muscle ring fibers (Ringbinden); both neural movement dysfunction and muscle pathology characterize it.
Primary mycobacterial infection of digestive tissues; pulmonary involvement is not implied by this localized tuberculosis concept.
Congenital skeletal dysplasia; atrial septal defect in 1/3 meets the approximate 30% threshold, with limited evidence. Hepatomegaly alone does not establish liver damage.
Intellectual disability and ocular abnormalities define the syndrome; optic atrophy is 80-99%. Respiratory failure is reported at 80-99%; recurrent infections alone do not prove immunodeficiency.
Carcinoma originates in the thyroid endocrine gland; microscopic vascular invasion does not establish a separate cardiovascular organ disorder.
Persistent severe neutrophil deficiency is a blood-cell disorder with impaired innate immune defense; individual infections are separate complications.
Inherited ventricular arrhythmia defines the disease; associated proximal skeletal muscle weakness occurred in 1/3 patients, meeting the approximate threshold with limited evidence.
Histiocytic nodular skin infiltration and destructive arthritis define the disease, each reported in 80-99%; other organ damage is not commonly established.
Primary cutaneous T-cell lymphoma: skin origin, hematologic lymphoid neoplasm and required lymphoma mechanism axis; extracutaneous damage is not typical across the group.
In situ carcinoma occupies hypopharyngeal mucosa; the pharynx belongs to the pulmonary axis under this scheme.
Intellectual disability, contractures and osteoporosis define it; hypogonadism occurs in 80-99% and strabismus in 30-79%. Elevated IgE alone does not establish immune disease.
Defined by developmental delay, intellectual disability and neurodevelopmental behavioral abnormalities; no common additional organ damage is described.
Congenital intestinal sodium absorption dysfunction causes persistent secretory diarrhea; fecal electrolyte abnormalities do not establish a separate endocrine or metabolic disease.
Mycobacterial infection supplies the mechanism axis; male reproductive tissues have no anatomical axis here. Urinary tract disease is not inherent to this concept.
Etiologic umbrella meaning unknown cause; it specifies no organ, and no organ axis applies consistently across its diverse constituent diseases.
Peroxisomal metabolic disorder defined by cerebellar ataxia and axonal neuropathy; abnormal smooth pursuit reflects neurologic dysfunction rather than direct ocular damage.
Inherited neutral amino acid transport defect is a metabolic disorder; no common direct renal, intestinal or neurologic damage is established for this umbrella.
Primary skeletal muscle degeneration causes progressive weakness and atrophy; motor delay follows muscle disease. Cardiac and pulmonary abnormalities are very rare (1-4%).
Benign tumor originates in or occupies the pericardium, which belongs to the cardiovascular axis.
